_comment: Databricks access by Entra group name (Gokul, 2 Nov 2026). One file for the AI agent (embedded in the worker) and for
tools/databricks/aim_setup.sh. The first level whose 'match' word appears in the group's last name part wins (checked
in this order); no match = left to the role assignment team. 'Workspace access' is given to every level; Databricks SQL
access to readers. Privileges are Unity Catalog privilege names (REST spelling). Never here: ALL_PRIVILEGES, MANAGE,
CREATE_CATALOG, ownership, allow-cluster-create, allow-instance-pool-create (refused by the code).

levels.why: workspace or data administration is never given by the agent or this script: a person decides
